verdict.rationale: The only agent-like evidence is an API endpoint for running a "published agent processor" on a document (datalab-docs-40) and an endpoint that auto-generates extraction schemas (datalab-docs-41). These are narrow, document-scoped automations invoked through the API, not a general built-in assistant you delegate tasks to inside the product (e.g., in Forge). missing for 10: an in-app conversational/agentic assistant in the Forge UI, documentation of what tasks can be delegated and how, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
